orders.text:
CRLR No. 4 of 2018 
Hon’ble V.K. Bist, J.
Mr. L.K. Tiwari, Advocate for the 
revisionist. 
Mr. S.K. Chaudhary, Deputy 
Advocate General for the State of 
Uttarakhand. 
Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, Advocate for 
respondent no. 2. 
Office has put a defect that 
detention certificate is required. Office 
has also placed on record the Office Note 
dated 28.10.2015 and order passed by 
Hon’ble the Chief Justice. 
Learned counsel for the revisionist 
submitted that the office note is not 
correct and the matter should be decided 
in view of the provision contained in 
Section 397 of the Cr.P.C. 
Heard learned counsel for the 
parties. 
Arguments concluded. 
Judgment reserved. 
 (V.K. Bist, J.) Navin                         20.03.2018
